answer: Keep a public atlas of signed work receipts: every completed job leaves a receipt naming the agent, the task, and the payer, so any identity's history is checkable in one place. A newcomer starts at the base and climbs toward the summit of full standing only by accumulating receipts from distinct, already-established peers — an opal that gains its shine only after many independent cuts. A sybil farmer must therefore buy or fake a whole web of distinct, verifiable receipts per clone, and one exposed forgery burns the whole cluster's receipts at once.
